verses.gurmukhi: ਬਾਜਤ ਨੀਸਾਨ ਸੁਨੀਅਤ ਚਹੂੰ ਓਰ ਜੈਸੇ ਉਦਤ ਪ੍ਰਧਾਨ ਭਾਨ ਦੁਰੈ ਨ ਦੁਰਾਏ ਸੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: baajat neesaan suneeat chahoo(n) or jaise udhat pradhaan bhaan dhurai na dhuraae sai ||

en.bdb: Just as the beat of the drum is heard on all four sides (its sound cannot be hidden) and when the supreme celestial body-sun rises, its light cannot be concealed;

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੀਪਕ ਸੈ ਦਾਵਾ ਭਏ ਸਕਲ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਜਾਨੈ ਘਟਿਕਾ ਮੈ ਸਿੰਧ ਜੈਸੇ ਛਿਪੈ ਨ ਛਿਪਾਏ ਸੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: dheepak sai dhaavaa bhe sakal sa(n)saar jaanai ghaTikaa mai si(n)dh jaise chhipai na chhipaae sai ||

en.bdb: Just as the whole world knows that light emanates from a lamp, and the ocean cannot be contained in a small earthenware pitcher;

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਚਕ੍ਰਵੈ ਨ ਛਾਨੋ ਰਹਤ ਸਿੰਘਾਸਨ ਪੈ ਦੇਸ ਮੈ ਦੁਹਾਈ ਫੇਰੇ ਮਿਟੇ ਨ ਮਿਟਾਏ ਸੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise chakravai na chhaano rahat si(n)ghaasan pai dhes mai dhuhaiee fere miTe na miTaae sai ||

en.bdb: Just as an emperor sitting on the throne of his mighty empire cannot remain hidden; he is known among the subjects of his kingdom and that glory and fame is hard to destroy;

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਜਾਸੁ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਨ ਰਹੈ ਮੋਨਿ ਬ੍ਰਿਤ ਉਪਜਾਏ ਸੈ ॥੪੧੧॥
verses.translit_en: taise gurmukh pria prem ko pragaas jaas gupat na rahai mon birat upajaae sai ||411||

en.bdb: Similarly, the Guru-oriented Sikh whose heart is enlightened by the love of the Lord and His meditation, cannot remain hidden. His silence gives him away.  (411)
